name: 05_rerun_not_failed
description: A rerun asked for on a run that is still running is refused as an illegal move before anything is sent, and no approval is asked for.

operations.purpose: read the state of the run before starting it again

response.reply_intent: report what happened to the rerun of run-0419

provider_script.expect_contains: the pipeline_run is running and run.rerun is not a legal move from there

response.reply: Nothing was sent. run-0419 is still running, and a rerun is legal only for a run that failed, so it was refused before the call went out. If it finishes as failed, ask again.

turns.user: rerun run-0419, the inventory snapshot looks stuck
